articles.headline: Pochettino: U.S. vs. Bosnia-Herzegovina like World Cup 'final'
articles.description: USMNT coach Mauricio Pochettino said that Wednesday's round of 32 match against Bosnia-Herzegovina will be like "the final of the World Cup."

articles.headline: Norway advance thanks to late Haaland winner
articles.description: Norway progress to a Round of 16 clash with Brazil after a 86th-minute Erling Haaland goal secured a 2-1 victory over Côte d'Ivoire.
